description: This file defines the VercelAiGatewayEmbedder class, which implements the IEmbedder interface to provide embedding functionalities via Vercel AI Gateway, wrapping an OpenAICompatibleEmbedder. It includes methods for creating embeddings, validating configuration, and retrieving embedder info. The class supports multiple models and handles telemetry for errors.

classes.name: VercelAiGatewayEmbedder
classes.description: Implementation of IEmbedder that wraps Vercel AI Gateway's embedding API, supporting multiple models and handling embedding creation and configuration validation.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the embedder with API key and optional model ID, setting up the underlying OpenAICompatibleEmbedder.

methods.name: createEmbeddings
methods.description: Creates text embeddings using Vercel AI Gateway API, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the embedder configuration via the underlying embedder, with error telemetry.

methods.name: embedderInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the embedder, specifically its name.
